name: cloudgpu
description: Compute infrastructure for AI agents: inspect supply, review billing, run jobs and save results.

interface.shortDescription: Inspect GPU supply, approve a budget, run a job and save results.
interface.longDescription: Discover capabilities and regional observations anonymously. Connect an owner-approved account to rent GPUs under fresh source-specific minute or started-hour billing, run jobs, save outputs and release resources. Regional observations do not authorize exact-region execution.
defaultPrompt: Rent a GPU, run this job, download the results, and shut it down.
